title: Add saved report filters
request:
Analysts rebuild the same filters on the reports list every morning. They want the last filter set to come back when they open the page.

Keep the change small: it is a UI change on the reports list. Do not add database tables and do not change the report data endpoint; the filters already defined in src/reports/filters.ts are enough.

We tested a browser prototype and it felt right, so this is about making that behaviour real.

answers.question: Should saved filters be private to each user or shared with the whole team?
Where should the saved filters appear in the reports UI?
answers.answer: In a dropdown above the report list.

verifiedFacts: The reports list keeps filter state in component state only
Report filters are defined in src/reports/filters.ts
The request forbids new database tables and changes to the report data endpoint
